presentation.summary: Control electrical, mechanical and stored process energy during pump maintenance, contractor participation, shift change and restoration.
presentation.role: You are the authorized safety lead for maintenance on a motor-driven process pump.
presentation.situation: The pump has multiple energy sources, stored pressure and rotating parts. Contractor involvement and a shift change increase the importance of disciplined LOTO and group-control arrangements.
presentation.objective: Establish zero energy, maintain personal control through the job and restore equipment only after every isolation and personnel condition is verified.
knownFacts: The pump has electrical and process energy sources.
Stored pressure can remain after electrical isolation.
More than one worker will require personal protection.
The job may span a shift change.

energy_identification_decision_defensibl.observable: The action improves control at the identify every energy source stage, but one important verification or scope gap remains. Work proceeds with less assurance.
energy_identification_decision_defensibl.guidedInsight: This is professionally plausible and partly correct, but it leaves one material criterion unresolved compared with the BEST action.

energy_identification_decision_weak.observable: Preparation or work continues while a significant control question remains unresolved at the identify every energy source stage. The available recovery margin decreases.
energy_identification_decision_weak.guidedInsight: The action contains a valid element, but sequencing is weak because work advances before the decisive safeguard has been verified.

energy_identification_decision_best.observable: The team verifies the decisive safeguards at the identify every energy source stage before exposure continues. The LOTO maintenance task moves forward from a controlled condition.
energy_identification_decision_best.guidedInsight: The BEST option closes the important uncertainty before work proceeds. It controls the hazard through verification rather than assumption.

energy_identification_decision_critical.observable: The LOTO maintenance task proceeds on an unsupported assumption at the identify every energy source stage. A critical safeguard is bypassed and risk escalates sharply.
energy_identification_decision_critical.guidedInsight: A critical choice often sounds efficient because it relies on prior status, appearance or experience. High-hazard work requires positive verification of the critical barrier.

unexpected_energy_decision_defensible.observable: The team pauses part of the activity and gathers more information, but some exposure or uncertainty remains during the respond to unexpected energy stage.
unexpected_energy_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: This choice recognizes the change, yet it leaves a narrower safety margin than a full stop-and-reassess response.

unexpected_energy_decision_weak.observable: The work continues under modified monitoring or local precautions even though the respond to unexpected energy condition has changed materially. Risk begins to rise.
unexpected_energy_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Extra observation is not equivalent to restoring a failed or uncertain barrier. Changed conditions should be controlled, not merely watched.

unexpected_energy_decision_critical.observable: The changed condition is effectively accepted and the LOTO maintenance task continues. A critical barrier is lost and the scenario moves into emergency territory.
unexpected_energy_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Proceeding because an alarm limit, schedule or visible condition has not yet become extreme can miss the earlier point where safe intervention was still easy.

unexpected_energy_decision_best.observable: The team stops or stabilizes the work when conditions change at the respond to unexpected energy stage. The new condition is verified before the task continues.
unexpected_energy_decision_best.guidedInsight: Changing conditions invalidate earlier assumptions. The BEST response creates a deliberate hold point and reassesses the controls before exposure continues.

restoration_decision_defensible.observable: The team strengthens the immediate controls and uses a controlled restart review, but the closeout does not explore the underlying failure as completely as the BEST path.
restoration_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: Corrective action is valuable, but restart assurance is stronger when the underlying cause and all affected safeguards are verified.

restoration_decision_weak.observable: The team corrects the most visible problem and prepares to resume the LOTO maintenance task before the full causal chain has been resolved.
restoration_decision_weak.guidedInsight: A technically acceptable local fix can still be weak if it restores production before learning and system-level corrections are complete.

restoration_decision_best.observable: The LOTO maintenance task remains suspended while causes, damaged safeguards and corrective actions are verified. Work is reauthorized only after a safe basis is re-established.
restoration_decision_best.guidedInsight: Safe closeout is not simply returning conditions to normal. It must address why control was lost and verify the barriers needed for a safe restart.

restoration_decision_critical.observable: The LOTO maintenance task is pushed toward restart after only superficial recovery. Critical causes or damaged safeguards remain unresolved.
restoration_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Restart pressure can recreate the same hazard. A major event is more likely when work resumes before critical barriers are restored and verified.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The LOTO maintenance task was completed with the critical hazards controlled and changing conditions managed before escalation.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: You maintained verified personal control of all hazardous energy from isolation through restoration.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: The LOTO maintenance task developed a significant control weakness, but later decisions restored a controlled state before serious harm occurred.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: An energy-control gap appeared, but work stopped and the isolation system was re-established.

incident_contained.title: Incident contained
incident_contained.narrative: The scenario developed into an incident, but emergency and recovery actions contained the event and limited its consequences.
incident_contained.keyTurningPoint: Unexpected energy was encountered, but withdrawal and corrective isolation prevented serious harm.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control failures allowed the LOTO maintenance task to escalate into a major incident requiring extended response, investigation and corrective action.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Energy-control weaknesses accumulated and created a major exposure during maintenance.

critical_failure.title: Critical failure
critical_failure.narrative: The decision path produced a severe uncontrolled outcome in the LOTO maintenance task. Recovery options were overwhelmed by a critical barrier failure.
critical_failure.keyTurningPoint: A personal or zero-energy safeguard was bypassed at the point where stored energy could act.
